call_points.text: EBITDA margin expected to finish closer to 16.5% from 16.1% now.
Wind fastener expansion of about ₹100 Cr to lift revenue from ₹350 Cr to ₹500 Cr annualised.
New-project pipeline over ₹1,000 Cr, with about an equal magnitude under discussion.
Direct-material costs are pass-through; indirect-material recovery is under negotiation and should expand margin in Q2.
Debt-equity is about 0.1-0.2; working capital increase is in line with operations.
High H2FY26 base may make percentage growth look weaker even if activity holds.
FY27 overall growth guided at about 15%: 13% OE, 15% retail, 20% export.
Aims for double-digit growth over the next two years.
Capex of not less than ₹300 Cr a year, 25-30% replacement, balance for customer-driven growth.
Wind energy fasteners expanding from ₹30-35 Cr to ₹50 Cr per month.
Railway fasteners run-rate at ₹2-3 Cr a month, targeted at ₹8-10 Cr a month by Q3-Q4.
Q4 EBITDA margin at 17% versus 15.6% a year ago, helped by stable raw material and lower power costs.
Non-auto margins are 100-200 bps above automotive, with a shorter working-capital cycle.
Dividend policy is to distribute 30% of profit after tax consistently.
Raw material inflation in nickel and aluminium after the West Asia conflict compressed gross margins slightly.
GM and Stellantis have downsized EV projections by 50% and postponed programs.

operating_notes.text: TVS Sundram Fasteners Private Limited holds 9,83,19,780 equity shares, or 46.79% of Sundram Fasteners, unchanged after Upasana Private Limited merged into it on March 27, 2026.
UFL Properties Private Limited holds 1,09,830 equity shares, or 0.05%, after Lakshminarayana Ancillaries and Upasana Properties merged into it on October 16, 2025.
Postal ballot on Suresh Krishna's re-appointment polled 16,40,31,124 votes, 78.06% of 21,01,28,370 outstanding shares; 99.83% in favour.
FY26 standalone domestic sales ₹3,911.39 Cr (+13%) and exports ₹1,457.88 Cr, down from ₹1,584.09 Cr in FY25.
FY26 standalone EBITDA ₹967.67 Cr, margin 17.2% versus 16.5% in FY25, which the company attributes to cost control and operating efficiency.
FY26 capex of ₹404.27 Cr on capacity expansion of existing lines and new projects.
Non-auto is about 35% of product mix including tractors, with margins 100-200 bps above automotive.
Railway fasteners run-rate is ₹2-3 Cr per month, targeted at ₹8-10 Cr per month (₹100 Cr a year) by Q3-Q4.
Wind energy fasteners expanding from ₹30-35 Cr to ₹50 Cr per month.
Q1FY27 volume growth was about 13% in tonnage, with ₹20-25 Cr of raw-material inflation in the top line.
New-project pipeline is over ₹1,000 Cr, with about an equal magnitude under discussion.
Europe is under 20% of exports; North America class 8 truck backlog at a 38-month high as of June.

timeline.summary: On 22 April 2026, Sundram Fasteners said it received Regulation 31A requests to reclassify LNL, UPP and UPL from the promoter group to public, after their mergers into UFL Properties and TVS Sundram Fasteners.

On 25 April 2026, Sundram Fasteners reported that shareholders passed the special resolution re-appointing Sri Suresh Krishna as Non-Executive Director for five years from 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2031, with 99.83% of valid votes in favour.
On 29 April 2026, CRISIL Ratings re-affirmed Sundram Fasteners' short-term debt and commercial paper rating at CRISIL A1+.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,693.3 Cr (+10.6% YoY), net profit ₹161.36 Cr (+29.6% YoY).
Sundram Fasteners Limited’s Board declared Rs. 4.25 interim dividend per equity share on April 30, 2026, payable on May 25, 2026, with record date May 8, 2026.

G Anand Babu (Senior Manager – Finance & Company Secretary) confirmed no unpublished price-sensitive information was shared during the May 5, 2026, conference call with M/s. Spark Institutional Equities Private Limited (Avendus Spark, Analyst).

On 12 May 2026, Sundram Fasteners filed the transcript of its 5 May 2026 Q4FY26 earnings call, where management guided FY27 overall growth at about 15% (13% OE, 15% retail, 20% export) and double-digit growth over two years.
Sundram Fasteners Limited’s Board, led by Senior Manager-Finance & Company Secretary G Anand Babu, will review Q2/H1FY27 results and declare interim dividend on October 28, 2026.
